label: Test rational exercise as formative rather than merely classified
summary:
Continuation of PR-1971 and PR-1962. Note: docs/notes/will-versus-chance.md#can-the-same-intrinsic-actuality-understand-and-produce-blindly-2026-11-25. Inspected the existing agency overlay and actual theorem A (b5b84276): intellect, will bridge, rational-power bridge, owned exercise and one power yield rational power classification of actual giving. This excludes a separate non-rational exercised power conditional on those premises, not wholly blind actual governance on a thin Exercises reading. Read Aristotle Metaphysics Theta.2/5 and Aquinas ST I q.25 a.1 co./ad 3–4 and a.5 ad 1 in the linked primary translations for navigation; no registered attribution. The understood account is the distinctive formative rationale of productive art; actual exercising qua rational inclination gives direct conceptual warrant for an operative apprehended good at some scope, not determination of every effect. The actual application of this strong sense to giving is OPEN. Contrast a separate intrinsic blind constituent with a proposed one-actuality contemplative source knowing its own objective good-directed propensity; identity does not transfer relevance under intentional descriptions, and explanatory aspect distinction alone does not establish real constituents. Actual governance of the productive exercise and residual selection among permitted realizations have different explanatory scopes. A rival supplying only the latter given a genuinely directed giving is not a replacement for the former. Neither case is a strict-simple metaphysical model. Own-good love, recipient-directed good, full existential PSR, and same-source/holder bridges retain their independent obligations. No frozen dictionary or proof change, new formal consequence or attributed claim. The earlier qualified review is preserved in assessment_history. Follow-up on base 30a9820018644fe98d92b9f10874c3382340a9ee: docs/notes/will-versus-chance.md#does-practical-inactivity-divide-the-source-2026-11-25 reads ST I q.79 a.10 ad 3/a.11 and q.77 a.3 as a finite-power control: differing practical roles need not distinguish powers under the stated formal-object criterion. This is not a strict-simple-source model. The q.3 a.6–7 actualizer/receiver and real-constituent criteria discriminate a genuinely decomposed account, not a distinction of explanatory aspects; q.25 a.1 requires symmetric treatment of the personal account. Adding nonreceptive knowledge of the actual giving does not by itself identify the known content as its practical measure. Invariant knowledge of a fixed contingent truth plus factivity creates the same necessity pressure on either account; relational self-knowledge does not by itself establish reverse grounding or formative governance. Temporal immutability remains distinct from modal intrinsic invariance; the existing same-token collapse bundle is reused without alteration. Primary translations were read for research; no existing q.77/q.79 passage witness was found in the bounded locator/path search, so no materialization or pinned attribution is claimed. Advisory novelty retrieval identified the substantial prior treatments. No new formal consequence, graph edge or premise discharge; this extension is independently reviewed with qualifications and published in draft PR-1962; the current assessment records the exact review and verification boundaries. Further simplicity/forms test: docs/notes/will-versus-chance.md#one-simple-productive-nature-and-many-forms-2026-11-25 examines De potentia q.7 a.1 ad 1, 7–8 and q.3 a.16 co., ad 11, 13–15. A unitary productive nature can be proposed as the ground of a differentiated whole without receiving each effect form; the actual constitution, not numerical labels, is at issue. A whole’s many parts, admissible alternative orders and its actual production remain separate. The strongest rival is an articulated primitive with the same explanatory stopping permission, not a certified strict-simple model. Actual natural-necessity premises cannot silently replace the granted nonnecessitation. Primary readings and advisory reuse are recorded in the note; no new pinned claim, Lean declaration or support edge. Proper-manifestation continuation reads ST I-II q.9 aa.1–4 and q.10 aa.1–2 as primary research controls. It distinguishes apprehended specification from exercise, tests the self-loving generative hybrid and recipient-relative proxy/normativity objections, and preserves a substantive intrinsic-final rival. Consult the current assessment and linked note for the exact positive case and reopening conditions; no formal interface or attribution record changes.

#2103 coverage audit at 632e76a81. (a) One-power intellectual giving and the willed withholding holder are already typed proofs b5b84276 and 963e9689, arguments b3806678 and 02f427bf. A uses intellect-to-will, rational-power possession and actual exercise of an own power plus uniqueness of power at the giver. B uses A's conclusion, same-holder withholding, a contingent witness, invariant set-up and holder intellect/one power. HolderRootIdentification.godHasWillFromWilledHolder (834ddcfa) supplies the conditional consumer to 66aecdd7 with its separate holder-to-GOD_4 identification. These proofs classify the exercise; they contain no content D as its reason.

(a) Merged #2020 covers the forward inference from actual apprehended specification to recipient good or direction on the same giving: PracticalSpecification.recipientOfPracticalSpecification and effectDirectionOfPracticalSpecification (e8ca49db, 785a4e63) extract a required recipient-benefit or end clause by omission of that clause while preserving other fulfilled clauses, then apply explicit recognition; omission and recognition are used by these two theorems only. (b) directsAllFromExerciseDirection (41390135) toward 123d394b is a bridge application, not an omission proof: it applies its RationalGivingDirects premise to the universal rational-giving premise, and that direction premise already gives the end-directedness of each qualifying rational giving. It is retained as a downstream consumer. Operative coverage 4be0f774, with definition references 5c308c8c, bace3032 and a84afabf, is a premise, and the control 6a0df6b9 holds rational giving and appraisal fixed while removing operative use. BenefitPlanWitness.recipientOfSomeGoverningPlan (c0f4d4d9) uses a narrower witnessed benefit test. (e) The missing step toward a94c5dfc is independently binding the actual exercise to the apprehended content that measures it. For the strongest noncognitive account, test whether the very same productive principle genuinely supplies recipient-relative fulfillment; changing beneficiaries can disconfirm a fixed physical proxy but alone cannot disconfirm an intrinsically recipient-directed specification.
blocker: Establish which content actually individuates the effect-bearing productive principle: the recipient good as apprehended and inclined toward, or an intrinsically generative noncognitive nature. An actual basing/specification argument would favor the former; a defended unitary recipient-directed constitution would strengthen the latter. Warrant actual recipients, capacities and outcomes before using reciprocal-benefit cases as evidence; such cases exclude a mere proxy but not the strongest recipient-directed nature. Preserve actual-population versus total-noncreation scope, complete A/B inputs and the separate recipient-good target a94c5dfc.

current_assessment.scope: Proper productive manifestation of intellectual appetite, noncognitive formal/final explanation and recipient-relative good in PR-1962; full A/B and holder-to-will interfaces unchanged.
current_assessment.assessment: ST I-II q.9 a.1 sharpens the positive personal explanation: a proper exercise of intellectual appetite has apprehended good as its specifying principle without that specification alone necessitating occurrence. This is stronger than ownership or rational classification. A hybrid can retain actual self-love while proposing a genuinely generative noncognitive orientation for external giving, but cannot simultaneously call the giving the proper realization of intellectual appetite under D and deny D any apprehended specifying role in that respect. The strong impersonal account can treat good as formal/final specification while the concrete source supplies efficient efficacy. Recipient-relative fulfillment need not reduce to a physical proxy, and causal derivation of rational powers does not make their constitutive norms delegated. These tests strengthen the personal rationale without demonstrating the strongest intrinsic-final rival insufficient. Actual exercise, complete contrastive selection and the source’s full modal constitution remain separate.
current_assessment.next_test: Establish which content actually individuates the effect-bearing productive principle: the recipient good as apprehended and inclined toward, or an intrinsically generative noncognitive nature. An actual basing/specification argument would favor the former; a defended unitary recipient-directed constitution would strengthen the latter. Warrant actual recipients, capacities and outcomes before using reciprocal-benefit cases as evidence; such cases exclude a mere proxy but not the strongest recipient-directed nature. Preserve actual-population versus total-noncreation scope, complete A/B inputs and the separate recipient-good target a94c5dfc.

assessment_history.scope: Practical-role plurality and formative use at the same intellectual source
assessment_history.assessment: The finite-power source account challenges a generic inference from practical-role difference to distinct powers; it does not model the strict-simple rival. Actualizer/receiver or genuinely distinct constituent relations could exclude a decomposed rival, but have not been established for the one-actuality contemplative proposal. Adding actual nonreceptive self-knowledge does not by itself establish formative use. The earlier underdetermination of actual governance is retained, with equal credit for matched actual supply and output.
assessment_history.next_test: The generic inference from distinct practical roles to distinct powers lacks the required formal-object qualification; even a source with one actual intellectual power need not satisfy a content-indexed governance claim by identity alone. Establish a same-source productive determination received as a genuinely distinct actualizer, or distinct intrinsic constituents, if using composition against the contemplative rival. Alternatively establish that the actual existential giving exercises the intellectual inclination in its formative mode. Actual self-knowledge of the giving does not supply that application without explaining why its content is the productive measure. A defended unitary contemplative account with actual supply and content would strengthen the rival; a demonstrated received productive determination would weaken it under strict simplicity. Preserve the same n, x and causal respect, apply the criterion symmetrically, and retain separate recipient-good and modal-scope obligations.

assessment_history.scope: One simple productive nature, differentiated effects and actual formative use at the same source; new De potentia controls in PR-1962.
assessment_history.assessment: De potentia q.7 a.1 explicitly distinguishes one power/operation from multiple effects and distinguishes virtual natural efficacy from many understood objects. The source combines these in an intellectual account; it does not endorse the noncognitive candidate. Nevertheless the composition objection needs actual receiver/actualizer or constituent relations, not a count of effect forms. The strengthened impersonal proposal makes one integrated whole its per se product and originates its differentiating conditions. Its strict-simple realization remains open. Multiple parts, alternative total orders and actual exercise do not entail one another. OnePower is an at-most-one constraint; the full A/B bundles classify owned rational exercise without content-indexed practical governance. The prior actual-governance underdetermination remains.
assessment_history.next_test: Establish a real intrinsic constitutive dependency in the proposed whole-order noncognitive efficacy, or establish that the actual productive principle is apprehended content in formative exercise. Apply the same composition criterion to the personal and contemplative accounts. A natural-agency premise fixing one total order must be defended against the expressly granted nonnecessitating rival, not installed through the word impersonal. Repeating one-power labels, counting forms or supplying a context-dependent finite example does not establish the required ultimate constitution.
